narrationTexts: I'll start by looking at the log file.
finalText:
**Redis died, and the service ate itself trying to cope.**

| Time (UTC) | Event |
| --- | --- |
| 02:14:07 | `redis connection lost: connect ECONNREFUSED 10.0.0.12:6379` |
| 02:14:07 | Cache falls back to direct store reads |
| 02:29:12 | Queue depth passes the 500 max |
| 02:31:44 | `worker-2` dies of heap exhaustion |
| 02:31:52 | `api unresponsive, killing process group — service down` |

Redis never came back. All 13 reconnect tries failed at [logs/app.log:224](logs/app.log:224) onward.

Retries fired every 80s flat. No backoff, no circuit breaker.

Next: check why `10.0.0.12:6379` refused connections.
